# Grill My COA

`GRADED` `READ-ONLY` `EVIDENCE-GATED` `HUMAN-APPROVAL` `POLICY-CAPTURING`

## Why these badges

- **`EVIDENCE-GATED`** — Surfaces where posted reality contradicts stated account purpose, rather than accepting the stated purpose.
- **`READ-ONLY`** — Chart edits happen in the accounting system, by you. This session produces the rulebook and an edit list.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Where it comes from | If it's missing |
|---|---|---|---|
| `accounts.list-chart` | no | integration manifest | chart of accounts export |
| `ledger.gl-detail` | no | integration manifest | your answers alone — flags that reality-checks were skipped |
| `COA.md / CONTEXT.md` | no | client workspace | created as you go |

## Outputs

| Output | Type | Where it lands |
|---|---|---|
| COA.md | markdown (updated inline, not batched) | client workspace — purpose line, rule, `_Not_:` warning per account |
| CONTEXT.md | markdown | client workspace — new or sharpened terms |
| chart edit list | list | chat — renames, merges, deactivations for you to apply |
| decision records | markdown (ADR) | docs/decisions/ — for hard-to-reverse structural changes |

## What it will not do

- Rename, merge, or deactivate accounts in the accounting system.
